categories.name: Antileak Containers
categories.description: Engineered with precision snap-fit lids and advanced grease- and moisture-resistant barrier technology, our Antileak Containers are designed for hot, saucy, and liquid-rich food deliveries. Available in versatile round and rectangular formats, these certified compostable and biodegradable containers ensure zero spillage, superior structural integrity, and exceptional thermal retention for restaurant chains, ghost kitchens, and food service providers.
categories.mobileDescription: High-performance leak-resistant compostable containers designed for hot and liquid-rich food deliveries. Available in round and rectangular formats.

products.name: Round Antileak Container
products.description: Heavy-duty molded fiber round antileak container featuring an ultra-secure leak-proof perimeter seal. Ideal for soups, curries, stews, bowls, and saucy dishes. Microwave-safe, freezer-safe, and 100% commercially compostable.

products.name: Rectangular Antileak Container
products.description: Commercial-grade rectangular antileak meal container engineered with reinforced ribbed sidewalls and tight-fit snap lid closure. Perfect for meal prep, entrees, takeout delivery, and multi-compartment food service. Heat-resistant and eco-certified.

categories.name: Plates
categories.description: Engineered from 100% natural sugarcane bagasse and bamboo fiber, our eco-friendly plates offer premium rigid strength, oil and water resistance, and zero sogginess. Perfect for high-volume commercial catering, restaurant dining, fast-casual foodservice, and events. Certified 100% compostable, biodegradable, microwave-safe, and PFAS-free.
categories.mobileDescription: Rigid compostable sugarcane fiber dinner plates. Cut-resistant, grease-proof, microwave-safe, and 100% biodegradable.

products.name: Round Molded Fiber Plates
products.description: Heavy-duty circular molded fiber plates engineered with a reinforced rim for superior rigidity and load-bearing capacity. Designed for hot and cold foods, sauces, and heavy entrees without bending or leaking. 100% PFAS-free and commercially compostable.

categories.name: Clampshell
categories.description: Heavy-duty hinged molded fiber clamshell food containers engineered for hot takeout meals, burgers, sandwiches, and entrees. Featuring a secure dual-tab locking mechanism, these breathable yet grease- and moisture-resistant containers prevent food from getting soggy while ensuring safe transport. 100% biodegradable, compostable, microwave-safe, and PFAS-free.
categories.mobileDescription: Hinged compostable molded fiber takeout containers with secure locking tabs. Grease-resistant, breathable, and 100% biodegradable.

products.name: Hinged Molded Fiber Clamshell
products.description: Commercial-grade hinged clamshell takeout box crafted from renewable sugarcane bagasse. Features reinforced structural ribs and dual front tab locks for secure closure. Ideal for burgers, lunches, and hot food deliveries.
